miniProject.title: Workload arithmetic and a falsifiable claim record for kernellab
miniProject.brief: Build the kernellab harness on your GPU and fix one transformer workload with its operation and byte arithmetic. Sweep one batched matmul from floor to plateau, score latency with an SLO rule, and file a falsifiable claim record that later sections test. The harness, manifests and sweep carry into every later section.
steps: Create kernellab with `harness/`, `kernels/cuda/`, `kernels/triton/`, `refs/`, `tests/`, `profiles/`, `reports/` and `manifests/` on your GPU. Build with `-arch=native`, size work to fit your GPU's memory, and record hardware, toolkit and revision in `manifests/env.json`.

Fix one workload card with medians, spread and arrival behavior, and keep separate cold and warm traces. Discard cold trials by rule, read the warm median from interleaved repeats, and keep raw samples with revision lineage.

Derive dense operations, attention operations and parameter plus cache bytes for your workload closed-book. Check each line against an independent reference, for example a published shape manifest, and keep the arithmetic sheet.

Sweep one batched matmul plus a device-to-device copy on your GPU with event timing and interleaved repeats. Plot achieved throughput against batch, report the knee and floor, and name the bound on each side of the ridge.

Implement Etalon Algorithm 1 in `refs/` and score one real timestamp trace with a fitted prefill deadline. Bound one kernel share with Amdahl, reconcile one baseline prediction with named residuals, and keep both reports.

File one claim record in `manifests/` before profiling with workload, baseline, timing boundary, prediction and falsifier. Add the training-step operations and memory check as a derived prediction, and keep the lineage from revision to number.
deliverables: kernellab with the environment manifest, workload card, and cold plus warm traces with raw samples.
The arithmetic sheet, batch sweep with knee and ridge bound, and the falsifiable claim record.
Etalon scores, Amdahl bounds and the baseline reconciliation with named residuals.

rubric.pass: The sheet derives operations and bytes against independent references, and every number traces to manifest and raw trials.
rubric.strong: Each residual names an independent line and leaves unexplained remainder unexplained.

rubric.pass: Cold trials are discarded by rule, warm medians come from interleaved repeats, and raw samples are kept.
rubric.strong: The report states which state each run preserves and shows convergence before the median.

rubric.pass: Your Algorithm 1 implementation scores the toy traces, Amdahl bounds precede profiling, and the baseline matches workload.
rubric.strong: The write-up shows a case where peak throughput and SLO qualified rate rank systems differently.

miniProject.feedsInto: Capstone laboratory: the harness, manifests, workload card, sweep and claim record are its foundation. Later sections add kernels, counters, timelines and integrations inside the same kernellab layout.
